result.title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
result.summary: World action models (WAMs) couple generative video modeling with robotic action prediction but typically require large video and action transformers, limiting deployment efficiency. We present LoopedWAM, a compact WAM that recurrently applies a shared six-block core in each expert, executing 30 transformer layers while storing only 12 blocks per expert. To account for their asymmetric inference costs, the video and action experts can operate at different depths: visual features are computed once per query, whereas action computation repeats at every sampling step. We further propose elastic self-distillation, which trains a single elastic checkpoint, LoopedWAM-E, across action-depth and sampling-step budgets. With only 0.58B policy parameters and no robot pretraining, LoopedWAM achieves 96.1% success on LIBERO, 91.9% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 52.2% on RoboCasaGR1, while using $7.4\times$ less peak GPU memory than Fast-WAM under matched inference measurements. On LIBERO, LoopedWAM-E achieves 96.0% success in 27.6 ms or 95.2% in 24.7 ms on an H100, providing multiple accuracy-latency operating points from a single checkpoint; with two sampling steps and four action loops, it stays within 0.5 points of LoopedWAM on all three benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that weight-shared depth preserves competitive performance, while aggressive action-depth reduction requires explicit budget-aware training. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, LoopedWAM succeeds in 71.3% of 80 trials across four tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LoopedWAM 与 LoopedWAM-E：视频与动作专家各自循环复用共享的六块核心，视觉特征每查询算一次而动作在每个采样步重复计算，并用弹性自蒸馏在动作深度与采样步预算上训练单一 checkpoint，以获得多个精度—延迟工作点。
AI.relevance_reason: 权重共享的循环深度与按模态不对称分配计算深度，可能为 LVR 中动态计算预算、迭代状态更新及长度/深度泛化的训练监督提供可核查线索，但其任务为机器人策略与视频世界模型，未涉及视觉语言推理。
